snippet.title: Goblin Goopmaxxing - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
GET GOBLIN GOOPMAXXING ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4107470/Goblin_Goopmaxxing/

Brew potions, create monstrosities, commit atrocities... 

EVERY SINGLE ITEM CAN BE TURNED INTO A UNIQUE POTION!!

If a goblin seems sad that you turned him into an abomination, just drop him into the meatgrinder!

Goblin Goopmaxxing is developed and published by BugFight Studio.

Press Kit:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hbUuBxIfBc_9qZB4TpZi-WmlFzxWVZWJ?usp=sharing
